(()=>{const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-history button')];if(buttons.length!==2)throw Error('Expected 2 preserved conversations, got '+buttons.length);const old=buttons.find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Keep my Willow conversation'));if(!old)throw Error('Old chat disappeared');old.click();return true})()

(async()=>{const id=(await import('/src/studio/store.ts')).useStudio.getState().job.id;const h=await import('/src/studio/assistant/chatHistory.ts');const before=await h.readChatArchive(id);let refused=false;try{await h.saveChatArchive(before,0)}catch{refused=true}const after=await h.readChatArchive(id);if(!refused||JSON.stringify(before)!==JSON.stringify(after))throw Error('Stale writer overwrote history');return {staleWriteRefused:true,threads:after.threads.length}})()
